description.p: Slotify is a design tool for Minecraft painted GUIs — chest screens whose title is a bitmap-font glyph, so a full 256×256 sheet paints a completely custom window over a plain container.

That trick fails silently: a wrong ascent draws the screen a few pixels off with nothing in any log, one stray opaque pixel drags every overlay sideways, and two providers claiming a codepoint means the later one quietly wins. Slotify measures those numbers instead of guessing them.

ul.li: Parses every font file in a pack and builds a codepoint registry, flagging collisions, dangling references and the next free slot.
Previews painted sheets pixel-perfect in a real chest window, with live advance, stray-pixel and ascent measurements.
Edits screens on a touch-first canvas — slots, connectable buttons, panels, wells, infoboxes and text in the pack's own bitmap font.
Exports the stray-stripped PNG and splices the provider into gui.json as an idempotent textual edit, never a re-serialisation.
Measures container geometry straight out of a client jar, and calibrates the title origin from a dropped-in screenshot.
Pushes a deploy plan to a server and reloads the pack over RCON.
